# Dependencies for the QueryMatching selector, CuraFlow, the selector-data
# scripts, and inference.py (inference with existing examples).
#
# torch_geometric must match your installed torch / CUDA build. The shipped
# checkpoints were produced with torch 2.1.0 (cu121) + torch_geometric 2.7.0;
# install torch FIRST (the right CUDA wheel for your machine), then the rest:
#
#   pip install torch==2.1.0            # or the cuXXX wheel for your GPU/CPU
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# DiverseFlow (Stage 1) has a separate, lighter dependency set — see
# DiverseFlow/requirements.txt — and is normally run in its own environment.

torch==2.1.0
torch-geometric==2.7.0
scikit-learn>=1.3
numpy>=1.24
pandas>=2.0
PyYAML>=6.0
matplotlib>=3.7

# Optional: only needed for data_processing/build_selector_data.py with
# --embedding-backend openai (real query/workflow embeddings).
openai>=1.0
